chunks: As for your saying: 'War has consumed the Arabs, leaving only the core of their souls.'
Know that he whom Right has consumed goes to Paradise, and he whom Falsehood has consumed goes to Hell.

key_terms.حُشَاشَاتِ: the core or essence (of the soul)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of war consuming the Arabs in Imam Ali's response to Muawiya?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) responds to Muawiya’s letter by interpreting the metaphor of war consuming the Arabs, distinguishing between those consumed by Truth (al-Haqq) and those by Falsehood (al-Batil). This dichotomy serves as a spiritual evaluation of the conflict, linking adherence to divine truth with Paradise and deviation to Hellfire. The statement reflects the Shia emphasis on the moral and metaphysical dimensions of political struggle, where the outcome is determined by one's alignment with Haqq.
